title: ಕರಣೇಂದ್ರಿಯಗಳನು ಹರಿಗರ್ಪಿಸುವ ಪ್ರಾರ್ಥನೆ
charanas:
ಮರ್ಮ-ಮಲ ಅಂಗಗಳಲಿ ಮದನಜನಕನು ಇರಲು
ಕರ ಪಾದಂಗಳಲಿ ಉಪೇಂದ್ರ ತ್ರಿವಿಕ್ರಮನಿರಲು
ಸ್ವರ ವಾಚಂಗಳಲಿ ವೇದವೇದ್ಯನು ಸದಾ ಇರಲು
ಕರ್ಮೇಂದ್ರಿಯಂಗಳಲಿ ಸರ್ವೋತ್ತಮನಿರಲು

ತೊಗಲಿನ ಸ್ಪರ್ಶದಲಿ ಕೋಮಲಾಂಗನು ಇರಲು
ಮೂಗು ನಾಲಿಗೆಗಳಲಿ ಮಧುಸೂದನನು ಇರಲು
ಕಂಗಳು ಕಿವಿಗಳಲಿ ಮುರಳಿ ಮೋಹನನಿರಲು
ಹಿಂಗದೆ ಕರಣೈದರಲಿ ಪುರುಷೋತ್ತಮನು ಇರಲು

ಮತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮನದಲ್ಲಿ ಪತಿತ ಪಾವನನಿರಲು
ಚಿತ್ತಾಹಂಕಾರಗಳಲಿ ಚಿತ್ತ ಚೋರನು ಇರಲು
ಪ್ರತಿಬಿಂಬ ಪ್ರಾಣಗಳಲಿ ಮುಖ್ಯಪ್ರಾಣಪಿತನಿರಲು
ಗತಿ ಯಾರೊ ಲಕುಮಿಪತಿ ಮುಕುಂದ ವಿಟ್ಠಲನಲ್ಲದೆ

pallavi.en: What is mine, I am unaware, for everything is yours, O Hari !!

anupallavi.en: The One who shines within and without, O Hrishikesha (lord of all senses), I beg you to protect me, my Lord.

charanas.en:
In reproductive, excretion organs, He lords as the Father of Cupid. 
In hands and legs, He exists as Vamana and Trivakrama (anu-mahat rupa)
In letters, intonations, speech, He sits as VedaVedya, the essence of all Veda shastras 
In all 5 karmendriyas, He beholds as Sarvottama, the supreme being who is complete.

In the sense of touch, He presides as the most soft-limbed, lotus limbed, Lord Rama
In the nose and tongue, he is Madhusudana, the sweetest among sweet, also the killer of Madhu demon
In the eyes and ears, he presides as the Enchanting flautist 
In all the 5 jnanendriyas, He is the Purushottama, the supreme personality, the super soul in every entity.

In the mind and buddhi(decision maker) He is all forgiving and ever pure Lord
In the Memory and self identity, He resides as the greatest theif stealing everyone's hearts and minds.
In the 5 Pranas which are the subordinate reflections of the supreme lord, He resides as the Father of Mukhyaprana (the one controls and lords all Jeevas and their activities until end of creation) 
What hope do I have, O Lakhmipathi, Mukunda Vittala, without you ??

notes: Seeing and remembering  Hari in the 5 karmendriyas (reproduction, excretion, legs, hands, speach), 5 Jnanendriays (skin, nose, tongue, ears, eyes), 4 antahakaras (manasu, buddhi, chitta, ahankara), Pranas ( prana, apana, vyaana, udana, samana) within oneself always dependent on Him completely.
